bio.text: Jack Williams, a Republican, has represented Alabama Senate District 34 since November 7, 2018, and is not running for re-election to that seat in 2026; his current term ends November 4, 2026.
He ran for Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries and lost the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
He previously served in the Alabama House of Representatives, District 102, from 2014 to 2018.
He graduated from Mary G. Montgomery High School; during his House service his professional experience included owning and operating J Bar W farm and Twin Oaks Nursery.
